an increasingly popular deep learning problem with a prac-
tical application to mobile cameras. This creates a need for
solutions that are not only performant but are additionally
compatible with real mobile AI hardware such as GPUs or
NPUs. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem

Figure 8. General method proposed by A VC2 team
Team A VC2 introduced MobileIE, a lightweight image signal
processing network designed for mobile deployment that balances
performance and efficiency using reparameterization, as illustrated
in Fig. 8. The architecture begins with an MBRConv 5 × 5 layer
followed by a PReLU activation. The subsequent main body con-
sists of two sequential blocks; each block contains an MBRConv
3 × 3 layer followed by a Feature Self-Transform (FST) module,
incorporating residual connections and a bias vector. After these
blocks, a Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention (HDPA) module is em-
ployed to refine features. Upsampling is achieved through a Pixel
Shuffle layer, followed by a final MBRConv
